settings: Tasks and input
20 supplied superclasses; 5 fine classes per task; 32 x 32 RGB images.
Data split
45,000 training / 5,000 validation / 10,000 held-out test images. Split seed 123; 50 validation images per fine class.
Shared network
Three convolution/ReLU/max-pool blocks (160 channels, 3 x 3 filters), followed by two 320-unit fully connected/ReLU layers. Twenty private five-class linear heads.
Initialization
Training from scratch; no pretraining, dropout or batch normalization.
Preprocessing
Training: four-pixel padding, random crop, horizontal flips. All splits: normalization using training-only channel statistics.
Updates and seeds
10,000 optimizer steps; seed 42 only. 8 images per task, 160 per update; about 35.56 training epochs.
Optimizer and schedule
SGD; initial learning rate 0.01; momentum 0.9; weight decay 0.0005. Cosine decay over 10,000 steps; clipping disabled.
Task weights
Equal fixed weights, 1/20 per task, for both methods.
Matching
Identical initialization, sampling and augmentation within the seed; all 10,000 batch hashes match. Separate projection RNG.
Evaluation
Every 100 steps; evaluation batch size 128. Best checkpoint: highest mean validation accuracy, breaking ties with lower loss.
Hardware and precision
Tesla T4; float32; deterministic PyTorch operations enabled.
Study scope
Completed single-seed comparison, with held-out test evaluation of each best-validation checkpoint.
